description: The filter that helps determine what threads/ replies to return.
name: DiscussionFilter

enum.name: NO_FILTER
enum.description: Return all threads or replies, regardless of their status.

enum.name: DELETED_ONLY
enum.description: Return only threads or replies that have been deleted.

enum.name: EXCLUDE_DELETED
enum.description: Return only threads or replies that have not been deleted.
